mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Glacial Path</titleLeft><mainText>Lissandra can teleport to her ice claw.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Lissandra casts forth an ice claw that deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Lissandra can <recast>Recast</recast> while the claw travels to teleport to its location.

mLocKeys.keySummary: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a frozen zombie that seeks out living enemies. Enemies near these zombies are <status>Slowed</status> by @MoveSpeedMod*-100@%. After @ExplosionDelay@ seconds, frozen zombies shatter, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ice Shard</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Move Speed is slowed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Lissandra throws a spear of ice that shatters on the first enemy hit, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Slowing</status> them by @Effect3Amount*-100@% for @Effect2Amount@ seconds, and also damaging and slowing the enemies behind them.

mLocKeys.keySummary: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Lissandra encases herself or an enemy champion in ice. Enemies are Stunned for @EnemyCastDuration@ seconds. When self cast, Lissandra enters Stasis for @SelfCastDuration@ seconds and restores @HealAmount@ Health, increased by @SelfCastMissingHPRatio@% for each @SelfCastMissingHPPerAbove@% missing Health.

In either case, dark ice eminates from the target, dealing @CalculatedDamage@ magic damage. The ice persists for @SlowDuration@ seconds, Slowing enemies by @SlowAmount*-100@%.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ring of Frost</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is rooted in place.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Lissandra creates an ice field, <status>Rooting</status> nearby enemies for @Effect2Amount@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
